answer_1.quote: SP-based KBQA models translate q to an executable logical expression denoted by s such as SPARQL, lambda-DCS, query graph, and s-expression.

answer_2.quote: We use the well-adopted exact match (EM) which measures the exact equivalence between the query graph of the predicted and the gold logical expression. We also calculate the F1 score based on the predicted and gold answers.
